title: Achievable Burning Densities of Growing Grids
summary: Graph burning is a discrete-time process on graphs where vertices are sequentially activated and burning vertices cause their neighbours to burn over time. In this work, we focus on a dynamic setting in which the graph grows over time, and at each step we burn vertices in the growing grid $G_n = [-f(n),f(n)]^2$. We investigate the set of achievable burning densities for functions of the form $f(n)=\lceil cn^α\rceil$, where $α\ge 1$ and $c>0$.
